jobs.description: Job Classification: Technology - Agile, Delivery, & Product The Prudential Long Term Care team is seeking an enthusiastic, creative, and experienced Senior Experience Designer to help shape, enhance, and scale PrudentialPeak®, our well-being and longevity portal. As a Senior Experience Designer, you will work closely with marketing, product, technology, operations, data, and compliance to deliver personalized experiences, enhanced capabilities, and deeper customer engagement for policyholders and their loved ones. You will play a key role in the continued evolution of PrudentialPeak®, helping the team connect customer insights, business goals, and design decisions across the end-to-end experience. In this role, you will bring a strong understanding of experience architecture, product strategy, and human-centered design to help advance the end-to-end experience for policyholders, support future growth of the site across other Prudential products, and explore opportunities to scale the experience to additional customer audiences. You will be expected to navigate ambiguity, frame design opportunities, influence cross-functional decisions, and move work forward in a fast-paced environment. Identify patterns across customer journeys, service experiences, and stakeholder needs to recommend new product opportunities, experience improvements, and roadmap priorities. Apply human-centered design practices to define problems, generate concepts, test assumptions, and refine solutions that improve the Prudential Peak experience across key moments in the customer journey. Create and rapidly iterate wireframes, concepts, and interactive prototypes in accordance with user stories and journeys. Co-create practical, feasible design solutions with developers, marketing partners, product stakeholders, and business subject matter experts. Build clear, evidence-based recommendations for design improvements, articulating the customer need, business rationale, expected impact, and implementation considerations. Riot is looking for an experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Sydney-based team and help create player-centered experiences for an Unpublished R&D Product. Riot’s mission is to put players at the centre of everything we do. We achieve this by continuing to create, evolve, and deliver new experiences with games like Teamfight Tactics, League of Legends and VALORANT.

As a Senior UX Designer working on an Unpublished R&D Product, you will own the design of significant player-facing features and help shape the product and feature vision. You’ll work across complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, partnering with designers, artists, engineers, producers, and other stakeholders to understand player needs and turn product goals into intuitive, accessible, and engaging experiences.

Your work will span discovery, strategy, interaction design, interface design, prototyping, and implementation. You’ll lead UX direction for features, establish alignment across disciplines, communicate design rationale, and support the team in delivering a cohesive player experience. You will report to a Senior Design Leader supporting the R&D Game Team.

Responsibilities:

• Own UX design for significant player-facing features and systems from early discovery through implementation and iteration.

• Lead the exploration and conceptualization of UX opportunities, helping teams clarify player problems, product goals, and success measures.

• Define and communicate UX direction through appropriate design artifacts, including strategy and alignment frameworks, research and discovery outcomes, journey maps, flows, wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and implementation documentation.

• Translate complex ideas into intuitive interaction and interface designs informed by player needs, usability principles, and project goals.

• Establish and evolve UX patterns and design system contributions that improve consistency and quality across relevant game experiences.

• Partner closely with engineering, UI, and technical teams during implementation to resolve design challenges, support prototypes, and help ensure a high-quality final experience.

• Facilitate design reviews and communicate design decisions clearly, influencing cross-functional partners and incorporating feedback from players and development teams.

• Collaborate with research, playtest, and analytics partners to plan evaluations, synthesize findings, and use evidence to improve the player experience.

• Consider platform and multiplatform needs when developing solutions that support the product’s broader experience strategy.

• Raise the quality of UX practice on the team by sharing knowledge, modelling strong collaboration, and supporting the growth of other designers.

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ years of experience as a UX, Interaction, or Product Designer working on digital products or games, or equivalent depth of experience.

• Proven experience owning end-to-end design for complex features, systems, or products in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

• Strong interaction and interface design skills, with proficiency in Figma for design systems, prototyping, presentation, and communicating implementation intent.

• Experience navigating complex and ambiguous problems, creating clarity, and making sound design decisions with cross-disciplinary stakeholders.

• Ability to articulate a compelling UX direction and influence product, design, engineering, and production partners.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across design and non-design audiences.

• A portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, player-centered design process and shipped or implemented work.

Desired Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Graphic Design, Communication Design, or equivalent experience.

• Experience designing for games, social platforms, or live digital services.

• Familiarity with Unreal Engine or other game development tools for implementation and prototyping.

• Experience with user research, usability testing, playtesting, analytics, or analyzing player feedback.

• Experience contributing to or leading design systems, interaction patterns, or multiplatform experiences.

• Experience working on distributed or cross-studio teams.

• Experience mentoring designers or contributing to UX craft standards and best practices.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

We will review your work as part of the application process, so please provide a portfolio link or work samples with your application.

Our Perks:

At Riot we strongly believe in work / life balance, and we encourage that with our open paid time off policy, paid parental leave (for both primary and secondary carers) and flexible work schedules to fit your lifestyle. We also believe that work should be fun, we have co-op gaming areas, a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of players and community, and all the snacks you would ever need to power through your day (even healthy snacks!). And that’s not all we offer, there’s also:

• Medical Insurance that covers you and your dependents
• Employee Assistance Program
• Wellness fund
• Donation matching of time and money to registered charities
• Learning and Development opportunities

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
CPLB(Coupang Private Label Brands)는 고품질의 상품을 경쟁력 있는 가격에 제공함으로써 고객에게 최대 가치를 전달하고자 노력하는 조직입니다. 신선 식품 브랜드 곰곰, 가정 및 반려동물 용품 브랜드 탐사, 건강 및 미용 제품 브랜드 비타할로, 라이프 및 홈 브랜드 코멧을 포함한 프라이빗 브랜드의 상품은 고객들에게 가장 저렴한 가격과 최고의 서비스로 훌륭한 제품을 선택할 수 있는 상품 셀렉션을 제공합니다. CPLB는 고객을 위한 가격, 서비스 및 선택 사이의 가장 큰 균형을 깨기 위한 우리의 사명의 모범 사례입니다. 또한 CPLB는 고객 및 중소기업과 함께 더 큰 혜택을 공유하기 위해 양질의 중소기업 파트너와 계속 협력할 것입니다.
CPLB는 다양한 배경을 가진 전문가들로 구성된 역동적인 팀이며, Brand Managment, Instock Management, Technical Services, Program Management, 디자인, 품질 및 컴플라이언스, 재무 및 마케팅이 포함됩니다.
우리는 전문 지식을 활용하여 시장 동향과 통찰력을 따라 고객을 위한 관련 제품을 개발합니다. 우리는 재고 관리를 최적화하고 제품을 경쟁력 있는 가격으로 항상 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 가장 효율적인 공급망을 설계하기 위해 노력합니다. 우리는 고객을 위해 더 많은 제품을 개발하는 반면 기술과 자동화 시스템을 사용하여 내부 프로세스와 비즈니스 효율성을 지속적으로 향상시킵니다. 우리 팀은 우리의 모든 제품과 프로세스가 규제 요구 사항을 준수하도록 보장합니다.
CPLB에서는 자신만의 전문성을 살려 고객이 사랑하는 브랜드를 만들 수 있는 기회를 찾을 수 있습니다. 더 다양한 쿠팡의 자체 상품 셀렉션을 함께 만들어 가고 싶다면 CPLB와 함께하세요.
팀 소개
품질 관리(QA) 팀은 모든 패션 라인 전반에 걸쳐 뛰어난 의류 품질을 확보함으로써 고객 만족도를 높이는 핵심적인 역할을 수행합니다. 시니어 품질 관리 담당자는 전문적인 기술 사양을 면밀히 분석하고 피팅 세션을 주도하여 복잡한 봉제/패턴 구조 문제를 해결하는 동시에, 견고한 품질 관리 기준을 수립하고 내부 파트너 및 제조 공급업체와 원활한 협력을 유지해야 합니다.
주요 업무
신제품 출시를 위해 1차, 2차 및 PP(Pre-Production) 샘플 단계 전반에 걸친 피팅 및 사양 검증을 총괄 관리하며, 원단·봉제·마감 처리에 대한 사전 승인 및 검사를 진행합니다.
디자이너 및 브랜드 매니저와 함께 드레스폼 및 라이브 피팅 세션을 주도하고, 기술적인 의류 구조 문제를 해결하며, 사진·도안·사양 수정 가이드가 포함된 상세한 피팅 코멘트를 배포합니다.
공차(Tolerances) 및 그레이딩 사양을 관리하고 표준화된 의류 구조 및 부자재 가이드라인을 정의하여 기술 표준을 수립합니다.
수정된 사양과 테크팩(Tech Pack)을 공장에 공유하고, 기술 문의를 해결하며, 진행 중인 수정 사항을 추적하여 부서 간 및 협력사와의 소통을 주도합니다.
자격 요건
경력: 의류 기술 디자인(Technical Design) 또는 의류 QA 분야 최소 8년 이상.
의류 패턴, 봉제 구조, 그레이딩 사양 및 테크팩 제작에 대한 높은 이해도.

국내외 공장 및 협력사와의 뛰어난 기술 관련 소통 능력.

고객 피드백(예: 반품 사유)을 분석하여 실질적인 피트(Fit) 및 사양 개선을 이끌어낼 수 있는 데이터 기반의 문제 해결 능력.

jobs.description: About Us Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America's leading retailers. Target Enterprise Services (TES) is close to the action when it comes to supporting guests, team members and enterprise partners. Through our Service Centers, we deliver exceptional experiences, resolve complex issues, generate business insights and help shape enterprise decisions that improve the end-to-end guest journey. You will lead an internal team of 6 to 10 Sr.Manager or Managers and 100+ team members servicing guest contacts to deliver exceptional guest outcomes, operational excellence and team engagement while influencing broader business decisions that improve the end-to-end guest experience. This role requires a balance of operational leadership, strategic thinking, innovation and enterprise influence. You will leverage guest feedback, contact drivers, data insights and operational intelligence to identify friction points, influence upstream solutions and improve how Target serves guests across channels. You will partner closely with Product, Technology, Digital, Stores, Operations, Merchandising and other enterprise teams to transform insights into action, drive innovation and shape the future of service delivery through automation, AI and evolving operating models. Core Responsibilities Guest Experience Leadership • Champion the voice of the guest by using service center insights, guest feedback and journey analytics to influence business priorities and improve experiences. • Ensure service center strategies align with Target's commitment to delivering differentiated and connected guest experiences. • Identify and remove friction points across guest journeys by partnering with enterprise teams to implement scalable solutions. • Measure, monitor and improve guest experience outcomes across channels and touchpoints. Service Center Operations & Organizational Leadership • Lead a large, complex service center organization through senior leaders, managers and team leaders. • Deliver performance across service, quality, productivity, cost and team engagement metrics. • Establish operating rhythms and accountability mechanisms that drive business results and continuous improvement. • Balance short-term performance needs with long-term capability building and transformation priorities. • Foster an inclusive, high-performing culture focused on guest outcomes and operational excellence. Insights-to-Action Leadership • Translate service center signals, contact drivers, sentiment trends and operational insights into actionable business recommendations. • Partner with Analytics, Research and Product teams to identify systemic issues and opportunities. • Influence enterprise decisions by framing root causes, quantifying business impact and recommending sustainable solutions. • Shift organizational focus from resolving individual contacts to eliminating the causes of repeat contacts. Product, Technology & AI Partnership • Partner with Product, Technology and Digital teams to influence the design of experiences, tools and processes that improve guest outcomes. • Evaluate emerging technologies, automation solutions and AI capabilities to increase efficiency and effectiveness. • Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows and operating models that enhance both guest and team member experiences. • Ensure technology implementations align with operational needs, controls and service objectives. Enterprise Leadership & Influence • Build trusted partnerships across Product, Technology, Stores, Operations, Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources and other enterprise functions. • Influence senior leaders through data-driven insights, operational expertise and guest- centered recommendations. • Drive shared accountability for enterprise guest outcomes across organizational boundaries. • Represent Service Center perspectives during strategic business initiatives and transformation efforts. Transformation & Change Leadership • Lead large-scale operational and organizational transformation initiatives. • Navigate ambiguity while balancing service delivery, experience, technology, talent and financial considerations. • Design and implement future-ready operating models that incorporate automation, AI and evolving customer expectations. • Lead teams through change while maintaining engagement, performance and business continuity. Talent & Organizational Capability • Build diverse leadership pipelines and future-ready organizational capabilities. • Develop leaders through coaching, sponsorship, mentoring and meaningful growth opportunities. • Anticipate evolving skill requirements as technology changes the nature of work and service delivery. • Create career pathways and capability strategies that support long-term organizational success. Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in service centers, contact centers, customer experience, operations, shared services or related environments. • Demonstrated experience leading large, complex service organizations and developing high-performing teams. • Experience improving end-to-end guest, customer or consumer experiences. • Proven ability to translate operational insights into strategic business actions. • Experience partnering with Product, Technology, Analytics or Digital teams to improve customer experiences. • Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and decision-making capabilities. • Demonstrated success leading through change and ambiguity. • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. • Experience leveraging technology, automation and AI-enabled solutions to improve business outcomes. Preferred Qualifications • Experience leading large-scale service transformation efforts. • Experience working within retail, e-commerce, consumer-facing or omnichannel environments. • Experience redesigning workflows and operating models using automation or GenAI capabilities. • Experience influencing enterprise strategy through customer insights and operational intelligence. • Experience managing complex cross-functional portfolios and executive-level partnerships. Working at Target We are committed to creating meaningful experiences for our guests and team members. As a Director, Service Center, you will have the opportunity to shape strategy, influence enterprise outcomes, develop future leaders, and make a significant impact on the success of Target's business and culture.

This leader drives the store’s business through a focus on performance (sales, inventory results, and operational compliance), people (training and development), and process (standard operating procedures and compliance standards). Drive company profitability through operational excellence, top-line sales growth, and expense control. Leverage store forecast and payroll budgets to support with store scheduling needs and communicate the needs to the GM to maximize productivity, achieve sales and payroll goals, and complete workload (e.g., omni-channel, shipment, replenishment, markdowns, and price changes) on time, and within the payroll budget. Leverage company programs, tools, and resources to drive improvements to meet Ulta Beauty’s goals for the store. Maintain prompt, regular attendance as the MM and hold store associates accountable to the Ulta Beauty attendance policy. People Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of top talent. Build a highly engaged team that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand through effective collaboration, open and honest communication, and prioritization of work. Create an inclusive environment that inspires and encourages the growth and engagement of associates. Support all aspects of associate professional development, including training, providing individualized competency-based feedback and coaching, succession planning, and individual development plans to enable continuous development and drive sales performance. Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance. Model a culture of operational excellence by leading by example, sharing best practices, establishing priorities, and providing support. Execute the Guest Engagement Leader program flawlessly through business ownership, associate coaching, and leading a helpful and friendly guest experience to drive business results across all Annual Performance Goals (APGs) metrics for the store. Process Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards. Adhere to and enforce Ulta Beauty’s dress code. TL;DR: We're hiring a People Operations Lead to drive and scale the systems, processes, and operating rhythms that keep Lovable moving fast as we grow across Sweden, the UK, the US, and beyond. You’ll manage and develop a regional People Ops team, own HRIS, payroll, compliance, employee lifecycle workflows, and contractor risk, and build the documentation, reporting, automation, and AI-native self-service foundations that make People Ops clear, reliable, and easy to navigate at scale.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

The Role

As the People Operations Lead you’ll lead and develop the existing People Ops specialists, own the systems and processes that hold the function together (HRIS, payroll, compliance, contractor risk), and build the durable operating mechanisms, documentation, reporting, and self-service workflows that let Lovable keep moving fast.

We’re an AI-native company, and we want our People team to be AI-native too. That means using AI to thoughtfully scale service delivery, improve data quality, reduce manual work, and make great decisions faster — while keeping a high bar for privacy, compliance, and employee trust.

This role combines scaled systems thinking, operational excellence, data rigor, compliance judgment, and a high-quality employee experience. You’ll be the first dedicated leader of this function who builds a consistent global People Ops model across regions.

What You'll Own

- Lead the Global People Ops team — manage and develop the regional People Ops specialists (Sweden, UK, Americas), moving the function from individual coverage to leader-led, cross-regionally consistent delivery.

- Own the employee lifecycle operating model — iterate and maintain seamless, scalable workflows across onboarding, job changes, internal mobility, leave, offboarding, employee data, and recurring People processes so employees and managers experience People Ops as clear, reliable, and easy to navigate.

- Payroll, Benefits & Compliance oversight — ensure clear subject-matter ownership per jurisdiction (Sweden, UK, US) while driving consistency in how the function operates across all of them; build audit-ready documentation, controls, and reporting that can stand up to enterprise-grade scrutiny.

- HR Systems & People Engineering — own HRIS strategy end-to-end (HiBob and adjacent tooling), including evaluation, implementation, integrations, data integrity, automation, access controls, and ongoing systems design, in partnership with the team’s People Engineer — and drive an AI-ready foundation (clean data, clear definitions, controlled access) that enables safe AI workflows.

- Process, playbook & self-service design — iterate our operations coverage with clear ownership, documented playbooks, intuitive self-service, and predictable, well-coordinated delivery — including AI-assisted self-service (where appropriate) so employees and managers can get answers fast without losing the human touch when it matters.

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years in People/HR Operations, including real experience leading and developing People Ops specialists, not just doing the work solo.

- Experience at an AI-native or fast-scaling tech company (or a clear point of view on what it means to run an AI-native People Ops function).

- Direct experience owning multi-country payroll, benefits, and compliance; Sweden, UK, and US experience is a strong plus given Lovable's footprint.

- A track record designing scalable People Ops systems and processes in a high-growth environment, moving a function from ad hoc to structured.

- Skilled at stakeholder management and influencing with data-centered narratives.

- Balances speed with rigor: can move quickly in ambiguity while building the controls, documentation, and quality bar needed for scale — including privacy-by-design, role-based access, and safe AI usage standards.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally, if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.
